title: Compact action button: state contract, hit-area & ARIA flow
creator: Asha Menon
description: Investigate and land a compact/compact-icon button state specification that unifies disabled/loading interaction semantics, touch hit-area contracts, and ARIA attributes. This ticket addresses multiple regressions surfaced in dark-theme and compact layouts: spinner clipping in icon-only buttons, disabled buttons still intercepting pointer events under certain layout combos, and inconsistent aria-live behavior for loading states. Deliverable is a design token contract, accessible usage guidelines, and a developer-ready handoff including QA checklist and visual diff references.
acceptance_criteria: Button token map updated with 'compact-padding-pressable' and 'compact-spinner-offset' tokens
Icon-only buttons show centered spinner without layout shift across all themes and densities
Disabled buttons reduce pointer event area (no click through) while preserving focusability state for keyboard users
ARIA contract documented: aria-busy usage, aria-live guidance for loading labels, and recommended role changes for icon-only actions
Design spec + redlines posted in Confluence and linked from this ticket
Regression verified on Chrome/Firefox/Safari and iOS/Android WebView by QA checklist
work_items: Audit existing button tokens and identify where compact density diverges from default
Create token proposals: compact-padding-pressable, compact-hitbox-expand, compact-spinner-offset
Prototype CSS rules and small JS polyfill for aria-busy toggling in legacy consumers
Design redlines and motion spec for spinner fade-in to avoid layout shift
Coordinate with engineering to land runtime feature flags and a canary rollout
Update Storybook examples and snapshot tests for new states
notes: This ticket is intentionally scoped to design and spec handoff; engineering tasks are created separately. Keep changes backward-compatible via token aliases (do not rename existing tokens without deprecation).
qa_steps: Load Storybook examples: default, compact, icon-only, icon-with-label across light/dark themes
Verify spinner vertical/horizontal centering at 16px and 20px icon sizes
Confirm disabled button no longer triggers pointer events but remains in tab order when focusable=false is not set
Run Percy visual diffs for compact set and approve only intended changes
Smoke test in iOS Safari and an Android WebView vesion of the app
design_decisions: Prefer adding tokens scoped to density (compact-*) rather than mutating global button tokens
Spinner placement should be token-driven offset from the icon baseline to handle custom font/line-height cases
Use aria-busy on the nearest interactive container and aria-live politely for status updates to avoid interrupting AT users
Avoid overlay-based loading for icon-only buttons; use inline spinner to preserve hitbox consistency
